exposure: maternal age group (adolescent ≤19 years vs. adult)
cohort: The study included 16,985 women (1,719 adolescents and 15,266 adults) who gave birth in a hospital.
finding: Newborn birth weights were significantly lower in babies of adolescent pregnant women compared to adult pregnant women, while rates of premature birth, pre-eclampsia, stillbirth, and Apgar scores were similar between the groups.
mod_finding: Cesarean section rates were found to be higher in the adult maternal age group.
cross-section timing: Data collected retrospectively between January 1, 2020, and December 31, 2023.
birth_weight: Measured, found to be significantly lower in babies of adolescent mothers.
gest_age: Measured, no significant difference found between adolescent and adult groups.
